text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahah. ☆ I must say, that was a fun battle.
It was far too brilliant to be a holiday gift.
And I'll give you credit for not getting in my way, boy. ♪
choice_data_list: You were totally in sync with everyone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あはは☆
　実に愉しい戦いだった。
クリスマスプレゼントにしては出来すぎているな。
坊やもワタシの邪魔をしなかったことは褒めてあげよう♪

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
I had no intention of working together.
Well, if it appeared we were on the same wavelength, then I shall offer
my praise to the other two as well. I only did what I felt like doing... ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
合わせたつもりなどないさ。
まぁ、
それでも噛み合って見えたなら、
あの二人を褒めてやるといい。
ワタシはワタシの好きなように振舞っただけだからな……♪

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
Have you misunderstood something? I only joined the battle because I
wanted to fight. If you really are grateful, then take that sword of yours
and use it to show me a good time. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
何か勘違いしていないか？
ワタシは自分が戦いたいから戦っていただけだよ。
感謝するなら、
その剣でいつか
ワタシを愉しませてくれ♪

text_block_list.name: Christina
text_block_list.text:
And to you, good work as well.
It's a strange feeling, being lauded by the likes of you.
But, well, it's not unpleasant, so I shall let it slide.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
お疲れ様。
坊やに労われるのも不思議な感覚だな。
だがまぁ、
悪い気分じゃないから良しとしよう。
